🎬 Wan Animate 2 vs My Own Pipeline. Which One Do You Think Is Better?

Wan Animate 2 dropped on August 7th and it skips the pose extraction step entirely, feeding the driving video straight into the transformer instead of converting it to a skeleton first. 
In this video I break down what actually changed from the original Wan Animate, build out a full LoRA stack and a Gemma 4 auto-prompting pipeline on top of the stock template, then run it head to head against SCAIL2, my own animation pipeline. Same reference image, same driving clip.
